content.content: deccy record <path>... --to <id> places the named file edits into the named node's change; --to is required and names the purpose's node. No invocation lands an edit outside an owning change; recording creates no node — when none exists the caller creates it first.
content.rationale: Purpose cannot be inferred from paths, so the verb demands it explicitly; symmetry with required --on keeps birth and attribution placed by the caller, never guessed, and recording stays placement-only so one verb never silently becomes another.
